title: selvedge.json
description: Selvedge target configuration: the exact origins the guarded browser may reach and the env hooks a user may approve. Validated by selvedge/lib/env-config.mjs, whose accepted key sets selvedge/tests/test-env.sh asserts equal to the property names here.

origins.description: Exact origins, each scheme://host[:port] (http or https). Compared as parsed exact strings: no regex, suffix or substring match. A non-local origin (any host other than localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]) needs allow_remote.

allow_remote.description: Permit non-local origins in the list.

allow_remote_mutation.description: Permit POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE to a remote origin.

hooks.description: Shell commands run at the repo root by `selvedge env hook <name>`, only with a user-scoped approval and only while every origin is local.
